header: What each Vertex module covers, in detail
subheadline: Five modules ship on one licence. These are the four that come up in every tender, opened in the order most evaluations work through them: Dispatch first, with the asset register usually mattering most by the end.

items.title: Vertex Dispatch
items.content: Scheduling, routing and SLA tracking for the whole crew. Recurring contracts generate their own jobs, so planned work and breakdowns share one calendar instead of two systems.

items.title: Vertex Field
items.content: The technician app. Job sheets, checklists, photos and signatures work offline for seven days, and the customer receives a PDF copy the moment the device reconnects.

items.title: Vertex Assets
items.content: One register for every chiller, lift and air handler you maintain, with serial numbers, warranty end dates and the full service history behind a QR label on the unit.

items.title: Vertex Insights
items.content: Contract profitability, first-time fix rate and travel time per technician, exported weekly. Halden Facilities uses it to decide which service contracts to reprice.
